text: Twenty videos ago, Helena Vasquez asked an honest question. This is the honest answer, stated end to end, one last time.
QAOA on ibm_brisbane did not beat the classical baseline on this problem, today -- a real finding, not a failure.
Three real questions stay open: does this scale, can mitigation close the gap further, how would other approaches compare?
A short list for a next phase: test at larger scale, re-test as hardware improves, compare at least one other approach.
This was a finished study, not a settled one. Series complete.
